title: When Ory and others came to California, c. 1919-21
summary: Foster, with the interviewers, tries to date when Ory and the New Orleans men came west, tied to the 1919 Black Sox scandal.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California
